about: Trigger-accuracy corpus for the ciso plugin's model-invocable skills. See RUNBOOK.md for how to run it. The surface is verbs, not certifications: a query naming HITRUST, SOC 2 or ISO 27001 selects the verb for the action being asked for, and the verb resolves the certification at runtime. hitrust-controls-compiler is intentionally absent: it is disable-model-invocation (maintainer-only, explicit /ciso:hitrust-controls-compiler), so it must never be auto-selected -- queries about its job appear here as negatives (expected: null). The disambiguation queries carry the most weight, because the verbs are semantically much closer to each other than the old per-certification skills were: interview (record a status) vs audit (report on statuses already recorded) vs review (read a code change) vs evidence (attach an artifact without changing status), and register vs init.
